scope: All current merchant categories and subcategories; curated extensible offering types, field capture and customer display.

text.valueShape: String with a meaning-specific length/format rule; blank and not provided remain distinguishable.

text_list.valueShape: Ordered text values with source/provenance where relevant.

enum.valueShape: One reviewed named option; unknown and not applicable are distinct from false.

enum_list.valueShape: Actual reviewed options, with no automatic feature or capability activation.

reference.valueShape: Stable scoped reference, source, version and authorized label projection.

reference_list.valueShape: Distinct stable scoped references; no arbitrary foreign-business records.

media_list.valueShape: Media reference, accessible description, order and applicable variant reference.

quantity.valueShape: Exact decimal string or integer, named unit, precision, basis and optional pack count; no unitless physical measures.

quantity_list.valueShape: Separate named quantities such as RAM/storage or weight/count; each has its own unit and meaning.

dimensions.valueShape: Separate named length/width/height/depth/diameter/mass as applicable, each with explicit units and measurement basis.

length.valueShape: Exact value and length unit, with endpoints/method where needed.

length_or_range.valueShape: Exact value or minimum/maximum, length unit, measurement basis and method; no guessed size conversions.

range.valueShape: Minimum/maximum and named basis; dates, ages, size labels and physical measures are not interchangeable.

range_with_unit.valueShape: Minimum/maximum, unit and basis; unknown and open-ended need explicit representation.

percentage.valueShape: Exact declared value and percentage basis; constrain to the applicable meaningful range.

count_or_range.valueShape: Integer count/minimum/maximum with named subject such as people or pieces.

duration.valueShape: Exact amount and unit, plus estimate/firm distinction; calendar periods remain distinct from elapsed minutes.

duration_or_assessment.valueShape: Exact declared duration/estimate with unit, or explicit pending assessment; no invented available slot.

money_or_quote.valueShape: Integer amount_minor plus currency and price basis, or explicit quote-only; display a starting price as a starting price.

policy_reference.valueShape: Scoped policy reference and approved public summary; current and accepted historical versions remain distinguishable.

charge_table.valueShape: Named charge, amount/currency, unit/basis, condition, inclusion/exclusion and pricing authority reference.

variant_table.valueShape: Stable variant reference, exact selected option values, specification overrides and owner references for price/stock; no assumed Cartesian product.

option_group_table.valueShape: Group label, stable choice IDs, minimum/maximum selections, compatibility, price effects and actual availability.

component_table.valueShape: Stable item/component reference or exact description, quantity/unit, included option, substitution policy and linked requirements.

material_list.valueShape: Material, component location, known proportion/basis and source; unknown composition is not fabricated.

size_system.valueShape: Exact merchant labels/system plus chart reference; no automatic equivalence between brands or systems.

measurement_basis.valueShape: Body versus garment, circumference versus flat width, named unit, endpoints and measurement method.

measurement_chart.valueShape: Versioned chart, exact size/variant/piece references, named measurement columns, value/range, unit, basis and applicability.

stock_reference.valueShape: Variant/location/unit reference, authoritative state, freshness and explicitly unknown/disabled state; no local invented quantity.

coverage_reference.valueShape: Supported method, location/area reference, eligibility result and freshness.

resource_reference.valueShape: Actual eligible provider/asset reference and permitted public label, distinct from its private master record.

availability_reference.valueShape: Exact scoped offering/resource/occurrence constraints and available/unavailable/request-only/unknown state with freshness.

schedule_reference.valueShape: Scoped hours, exact duration, buffers, lead time/horizon and exceptions in Africa/Nairobi; underlying owner remains authoritative.

structured_request.valueShape: Reviewed named fields, types, conditions and privacy; no undifferentiated public customer-notes blob.

contact_reference.valueShape: Existing authorized contact reference and only necessary request-specific details.

customization_schema.merchantControl: Customization choices and private response form
customization_schema.valueShape: Allowed text/media/measurements/options, compatibility and approval rules; actual personal text/uploads stay private.

verification_reference.valueShape: Evidence reference, applicable review state and permitted public claim projection; uploading is not approval.

technical_specs.valueShape: Specific reviewed key, typed value, unit/standard/rating method, compatibility and source; merchant extensions do not automatically become shared filters.

electrical_specs.valueShape: Applicable input/output voltage, current, power, frequency, connector, battery capacity and rating method, each distinct with unit.

camera_specs.valueShape: Named camera/lens, resolution, sensor/lens features and source with units where relevant.

display_specs.valueShape: Diagonal and unit, pixel width/height, panel type, refresh rate and supported interfaces; actual configured values only.

rating_table.valueShape: Rating value, scale/method, unit and source/version; unlike rating systems cannot be compared silently.

condition_report.valueShape: Actual grade definition, defects, replaced parts and measured condition where supplied; private serial data excluded.

connector_pair.valueShape: Named connector/gender at each end and actual supported version/protocol.

power_profile_table.valueShape: Port ID/type, direction, voltage/current/power, supported protocol and shared versus per-port maximum, with units.

electrical_capacity.valueShape: Rated capacity value/unit, relevant rated voltage, cell-versus-output basis and source; no invented delivered runtime.

labelled_product_specs.valueShape: Exact identity/form, ingredient or strength value/unit/basis and pack quantity as applicable; no generated dosage or efficacy advice.

nutrition_table.valueShape: Nutrient, quantity/unit, per-serving/per-100-unit basis, serving quantity and authoritative label source.

secure_document_reference.valueShape: Purpose, permitted document type and secure reference; never public raw content or generic merchant access.

asset_class_reference.valueShape: Guaranteed specific asset versus class, promised features, or-similar policy and actual resource-allocation reference.

capacity_table.valueShape: Named limit such as seats/bags/people, value/unit, dimensions/assumptions and actual applicable configuration.

distance_policy.valueShape: Unlimited or allowance value/distance unit/period, excess charge/currency/basis and applicable policy version.

deposit_policy_reference.valueShape: Applicable amount/currency or approved calculation, collection/release timing, conditions and authority.

interval_policy.valueShape: Local date versus timed instant, end-exclusive semantics where applicable, minimum/maximum, buffers and charging/late policy.

location_option_table.valueShape: Permitted place references, directions, time restrictions and additional charges; exact private customer places remain private.

duration_policy.valueShape: Included time/unit, trigger, excess-time charge/currency/basis and approved terms.

location_request.valueShape: Purpose-specific private coordinates/address/access details and service-area eligibility; no public listing exposure.

date_time_selection.valueShape: Explicit local date or offset-bearing instant, interval endpoints and Africa/Nairobi display; feasibility rechecked by owner.

capacity_request.valueShape: People, bags, child/accessibility/equipment preferences and units, checked against actual compatible capacity.

location_reference.valueShape: Permitted public venue identity, location, access and accessibility facts from their owner.

session_reference.valueShape: Occurrence ID, local/offset-bearing start/end, venue, actual capacity and source freshness.

ticket_option_table.valueShape: Tier/zone/seat choice, occurrence, included access, quantity limits, price reference and shared inventory/capacity allocation.

deliverable_table.valueShape: Output, quantity/unit, format, turnaround, revision scope and rights reference.

inclusion_table.valueShape: Named component, included/excluded/optional state, quantity/unit, fee reference and supplier confirmation dependency.

entitlement_table.valueShape: Benefit, credit/access/delivery unit, quantity/period, limits and linked booking/order workflow; no automatic reservations.

period_policy.valueShape: Exact dates/calendar period or elapsed duration, unit, minimum term, expiry and explicit renewal/charge consent policy.

itinerary_table.valueShape: Day/local date/timed milestone, stop/activity, travel/overnight scope, inclusions and actual supplier references.

task_table.valueShape: Named included/excluded/optional tasks, workload/unit, deliverable and assessment/acceptance rule.

item_rate_table.valueShape: Item/care category, count/weight unit, price reference, applicable minimums and assessment adjustment policy.

linked_window_reference.valueShape: Collection window, workload/processing constraints, feasible return window and actual authority/acceptance state.

business_reference.valueShape: Actual business identity and permitted verification projection; no invented approved badge.

intake_schema.valueShape: Named input, type, required condition and purpose/access rule; actual responses live privately in the transaction.

route_table.valueShape: Origin/destination zones/ports, included legs, mode, estimate/firm status and authoritative service coverage.

charge_basis.valueShape: Unit such as kg/m3/container, minimums, rounding and carrier-approved conversion rule/source; never invent a divisor.

cargo_dimension_table.valueShape: Piece ID/count, length/width/height and gross mass with units; actual volume/chargeable mass derives through approved carrier rules.

storage_capacity.valueShape: Unit type, usable dimensions/height, area/volume/pallet quantity and constraints with units; separate allocated and free capacity.

capacity_reference.valueShape: Occurrence/resource pool, unit, permitted quantities and actual authoritative availability; visible group-size limits are separate from free places.

integer_or_range.valueShape: Known integer or explicit minimum/maximum and named meaning, such as model year; unknown values stay unknown.

vehicle_body.valueShape: Actual body-style descriptor and separate integer door count; class alternatives and guaranteed features are distinguished.

gift_item_specs.valueShape: Specific base item type, material, named dimensions with units, actual included pieces and variant choices; personalization is separate.

customerDestinations.details: Offering detail page description and inclusions
customerDestinations.fulfilment: Delivery, pickup, visit or access information
customerDestinations.schedule: Supported date, time, duration and capacity selection
customerDestinations.request_form: Private customer order, booking or enquiry input

common.name.label: Offering name
common.name.guidance: Name the actual offering; the merchant identity is referenced separately.

common.summary.label: Short description
common.summary.guidance: Explain what the customer receives without replacing structured specifications.

common.media.label: Photos or relevant media
common.media.guidance: Accurate media with accessible descriptions; link media to actual variants where relevant.

common.type.label: Specific offering type
common.type.guidance: A registered template chosen for the item, not inferred solely from merchant category.

common.locations.label: Applicable branches or channels
common.locations.guidance: Use actual permitted locations and supported methods; a digital service can have a remote channel.

common.source.label: Content source and external identity
common.source.guidance: Preserve stable internal/external IDs and edit ownership; not a public product specification.

sale.unit.label: Sale unit and pack quantity
sale.unit.guidance: Explicit count, weight or volume unit, precision and contents per sale unit.

sale.variants.label: Actual purchasable combinations

requirement.when: when options change the purchased item

sale.variants.guidance: Stable variant IDs; list actual combinations, never an automatic size-by-colour cross-product.

sale.condition.label: Item condition
sale.condition.guidance: New, used or refurbished as applicable; explain the actual grading when relevant.

sale.returns.label: Applicable return and warranty references
sale.returns.guidance: Reference the effective policy; inherited policies require explicit scope and overrides.

price.basis.label: How the price is calculated
price.basis.guidance: Fixed, per declared unit, variant, duration, person, package, starting estimate or quote-only.

price.amount.label: Published price or quote status
price.amount.guidance: Money uses integer minor units and currency; quote-only is not a zero price. Never auto-convert legacy whole-KES fields.

price.charges.label: Included and additional charges
price.charges.guidance: Explicit unit, applicability, inclusions and source; show the selected total before commitment.

price.policy.label: Price and policy version
price.policy.guidance: Accepted work retains the applicable version; prices come from their declared authority.

stock.mode.label: Stock control mode
stock.mode.guidance: Internal, external, hybrid or explicitly disabled. Unknown stock must remain unknown.

stock.availability.label: Availability by variant and location
stock.availability.guidance: Reference authoritative stock and unit; a merchant's shop hours are not proof of stock.

fulfilment.methods.label: Delivery, pickup, visit or remote methods
fulfilment.methods.guidance: Only supported methods for the selected listing and location.

fulfilment.coverage.label: Service area and pickup locations

requirement.when: when physical delivery or customer-location service is offered

fulfilment.coverage.guidance: Exact authoritative coverage; show eligibility for the selected customer location.

fulfilment.lead_time.label: Preparation or fulfilment lead time
fulfilment.lead_time.guidance: Exact amount and unit; estimate versus firm promise must be labelled.

fulfilment.instructions.label: Customer-facing fulfilment instructions
fulfilment.instructions.guidance: Public instructions exclude personal access credentials and internal notes.

service.scope.label: What the service includes and excludes
service.scope.guidance: Define the actual task or deliverables and any assessment boundary.

service.methods.label: Service location or format
service.methods.guidance: Merchant venue, customer location or remote where explicitly configured.

service.duration.label: Service duration and unit
service.duration.guidance: Exact duration when bookable; assessment-required is explicit and cannot promise a slot.

service.provider.label: Eligible provider or resource description

requirement.when: when resources or staff are needed

service.provider.guidance: Public provider details are an allowed projection; internal staffing records remain private.

service.preparation.label: Customer preparation and prerequisites
service.preparation.guidance: Merchant-approved administrative instructions; no generated clinical or professional advice.

service.cancellation.label: Cancellation, reschedule and no-show terms
service.cancellation.guidance: Use applicable authority and version; no universal thresholds are invented here.

schedule.availability.label: Available dates, times or capacity
schedule.availability.guidance: Derived from the actual authority, resource eligibility and current capacity; unknown is distinct from unavailable.

schedule.intake.label: How acceptance works
schedule.intake.guidance: Use the effective model's allowed intake mode; a request is not a confirmed reservation.

schedule.rules.label: Lead time, buffers and booking horizon
schedule.rules.guidance: Use exact configured rules with Kenya time; preserve local dates separately from instants.

request.scope.label: Requested work and preferences

requirement.when: when a quote or assessment is needed

request.scope.guidance: Collect only information needed to scope this request; never place it in public specifications.

request.place_time.label: Relevant location, dates and quantities

requirement.when: when needed for the selected service

request.place_time.guidance: Only applicable fields; exact private addresses and access details remain restricted.

request.contact.label: Customer contact for this request
request.contact.guidance: Use authorized customer/contact records and purpose-limited access.

apparel.brand.label: Brand and style reference inherited from listing identity
apparel.brand.guidance: Use actual labels; authenticity claims need their evidence owner.

apparel.fabric.label: Fabric composition
apparel.fabric.guidance: Known materials and proportions; unknown proportions remain unknown.

apparel.fit.label: Fit and silhouette
apparel.fit.guidance: Named merchant fit guidance such as fitted or relaxed; do not equate it across brands.

apparel.stretch.label: Stretch or adjustability
apparel.stretch.guidance: No stretch, stretch, adjustable or not provided; unanswered is not No.

apparel.care.label: Care instructions
apparel.care.guidance: Use garment label or merchant-confirmed instructions.

apparel.colour.label: Available colours and patterns

requirement.when: when colour or pattern choices exist

apparel.colour.guidance: Link real variants and photographs; sold-out combinations remain explicit.

sizing.system.label: Size labels and sizing system
sizing.system.guidance: Preserve merchant labels and named system; one-size still needs fit guidance.

sizing.basis.label: Measurement basis and units

requirement.when: when a measurement chart is supplied

sizing.basis.guidance: Body versus garment, circumference versus flat width, cm versus inches; never infer a universal conversion between size labels.

sizing.rows.label: Chart rows for actual sizes
sizing.rows.guidance: Reference an accurate versioned chart or item-specific rows; each size has separate values/ranges and measurement instructions.

dress.bust.label: Bust measurement by size

requirement.when: when applicable to the garment fit

dress.bust.guidance: Explicit unit and basis from the chart; if not known show not provided rather than estimate.

dress.waist.label: Waist measurement by size

requirement.when: when the design defines a waist fit

dress.waist.guidance: Allow an elastic or adjustable range and explain how it was measured.

dress.hips.label: Hip measurement by size

requirement.when: when the design defines a hip fit

dress.hips.guidance: Do not reuse waist or bust values as hip measurements.

dress.length.label: Dress length by size
dress.length.guidance: State measurement endpoints and unit; length descriptors alone do not supply a measurement.

dress.neckline.label: Neckline
dress.neckline.guidance: Relevant dress neckline or explicitly not provided.

dress.closure.label: Closure or fastening
dress.closure.guidance: Actual fastening, pull-on or adjustable construction.

dress.sleeve_style.label: Sleeve style
dress.sleeve_style.guidance: Sleeveless is an explicit applicable value.

dress.sleeve_length.label: Sleeve length by size

requirement.when: when the dress has a measurable sleeve

dress.sleeve_length.guidance: State measurement endpoints and unit; not applicable to a sleeveless design.

dress.lining.label: Lining
dress.lining.guidance: Merchant-confirmed lined/unlined information; unknown remains labelled.

dress.opacity.label: Opacity or transparency description
dress.opacity.guidance: Actual merchant-confirmed coverage description; do not infer it from fabric alone.

shirt.chest.label: Chest or bust by size
shirt.chest.guidance: Label whether body or garment and flat width or circumference.

requirement.when: when the construction has a defined shoulder

shirt.sleeve.label: Sleeve length by size

requirement.when: when sleeves are present and this measure applies

shirt.sleeve.guidance: State how the sleeve was measured.

shirt.collar.label: Collar or neckline style
shirt.collar.guidance: Actual construction, not an inferred style.

shirt.sleeve_style.label: Sleeve style
shirt.sleeve_style.guidance: Short, long, sleeveless or actual supported type.

shirt.fastening.label: Fastening or closure
shirt.fastening.guidance: Actual button, zip, pull-on or other construction.

bottom.inseam.label: Inseam by size
bottom.inseam.guidance: Not applicable to skirts; explicit length unit.

bottom.length.label: Overall length by size
bottom.length.guidance: State endpoints for trousers, shorts or skirts.

outerwear.layers.label: Lining, insulation and intended layers
outerwear.layers.guidance: Describe actual construction and fit allowance.

outerwear.features.label: Hood, pockets and fastening
outerwear.features.guidance: Declared features; performance claims need confirmed supporting information.

children.age.label: Indicative age band
children.age.guidance: Age is guidance, not a substitute for actual size and fit measurements.

requirement.when: when the label uses height sizing

children.features.label: Adjustable features and school requirements
children.features.guidance: Specify actual fastenings and school/uniform design where applicable.

footwear.system.label: Shoe size system and labels
footwear.system.guidance: EU, UK, US or merchant system as actually labelled; no invented cross-system equivalence.

footwear.length.label: Foot or internal length by size
footwear.length.guidance: Clearly distinguish foot length from shoe internal length and label units.

footwear.width.label: Width or width fitting by size
footwear.width.guidance: Use actual width scale or measured width with unit.

footwear.closure.label: Fastening and intended use
footwear.closure.guidance: Describe actual closure and use without unsupported safety/performance claims.

footwear.colour.label: Colours and valid size combinations
footwear.colour.guidance: Real variant matrix with separate price and stock references.

bag.material.label: Outer and lining materials
bag.material.guidance: Identify actual materials and care instructions.

bag.capacity.label: Capacity and compatible device size
bag.capacity.guidance: Separate litres from compatible laptop diagonal; dimensions must support any fit claim.

bag.features.label: Compartments, closure and straps
bag.features.guidance: Include adjustable strap range where relevant.

watch.movement.label: Movement and power type
watch.movement.guidance: Mechanical, quartz, rechargeable or actual specified type.

watch.case.label: Case dimensions
watch.case.guidance: Case diameter, width and thickness as relevant, each with units; materials are captured separately.

watch.strap.label: Strap material and fit range
watch.strap.guidance: Wrist circumference range with units; replaceable strap details where relevant.

watch.features.label: Functions and stated resistance rating
watch.features.guidance: Reproduce confirmed manufacturer ratings without inferring a safe activity.

accessory.kind.label: Accessory type
accessory.kind.guidance: Jewellery, belt, hat, scarf or other specific registered type.

accessory.material.label: Material and finish
accessory.material.guidance: Separate material from plating or finish.

accessory.fit.label: Dimensions and adjustable fit
accessory.fit.guidance: Ring system, belt length, hat circumference or item dimensions with explicit units.

accessory.features.label: Closure, set contents and care
accessory.features.guidance: Make pair versus single and included pieces clear.

personal_care.kind.label: Product type and intended label use
personal_care.kind.guidance: Identify the actual product; suitability claims must come from confirmed label information.

personal_care.contents.label: Ingredients, materials and pack contents
personal_care.contents.guidance: Use manufacturer/label information; do not invent efficacy or safety claims.

personal_care.quantity.label: Net contents and pack count
personal_care.quantity.guidance: Explicit mass, volume or count units; distinguish net contents from shipping weight.

personal_care.instructions.label: Label instructions, cautions and storage

requirement.when: when supplied or required for this product

personal_care.instructions.guidance: Reproduce approved product information, not generated treatment or usage advice.

personal_care.variants.label: Formula, shade, scent or compatibility options
personal_care.variants.guidance: Actual variant identity and contents; prices and availability use their own owners.

intimate.material.label: Material and dimensions
intimate.material.guidance: State confirmed material and applicable dimensions with units.

intimate.compatibility.label: Compatibility and care information
intimate.compatibility.guidance: Use verified product instructions; never infer medical suitability.

intimate.power.label: Power, charging and included accessories
intimate.power.guidance: Actual power specifications and box contents.

restricted.eligibility.label: Applicable age or eligibility policy
restricted.eligibility.guidance: Reference approved product-specific rules; this design does not set legal thresholds.

restricted.packaging.label: Packaging choices
restricted.packaging.guidance: Accurate discreet or branded options and relevant charge.

restricted.verification.label: Publication or eligibility evidence
restricted.verification.guidance: Seller answers do not create verified status. Checks belong to their authorized owner.

tobacco.format.label: Format and pack count
tobacco.format.guidance: Single, pack, carton or cigar box with explicit unit count.

tobacco.origin.label: Declared origin and product dimensions
tobacco.origin.guidance: For cigars include length and ring-gauge system where provided; no invented conversions.

tobacco.strength.label: Labelled composition and warnings

requirement.when: when present on the product label

tobacco.strength.guidance: No health comparisons or inferred lower-risk claims.

vape.kind.label: Device, refill or accessory type
vape.kind.guidance: Distinguish complete device, liquid, pod, coil and other parts.

vape.compatibility.label: Compatible models and fittings

requirement.when: when a component or refill is sold

vape.compatibility.guidance: Explicit supported devices and compatibility source.

vape.contents.label: Liquid volume, labelled composition and strength
vape.contents.guidance: Preserve units and manufacturer labels; do not infer health or legal claims.

vape.power.label: Battery, charging and included components
vape.power.guidance: Power/connector details and actual contents; no unsupported performance promise.

beverage.producer.label: Brand, producer and product name
beverage.producer.guidance: Exact labelled product; origin is a separate confirmed fact.

beverage.volume.label: Container volume and pack count
beverage.volume.guidance: Explicit mL/L and units per pack, with supported combinations.

beverage.ingredients.label: Ingredients and declared allergens
beverage.ingredients.guidance: Preserve label source and unknown state; absence of data is not allergen-free.

beverage.storage.label: Storage and serving condition
beverage.storage.guidance: Ambient/chilled choices must match supported fulfilment.

alcohol.abv.label: Alcohol by volume
alcohol.abv.guidance: Use exact labelled ABV; distinguish non-alcoholic variants.

alcohol.vintage.label: Vintage, age statement or non-vintage

requirement.when: when this product carries such a statement

alcohol.vintage.guidance: Do not invent a vintage or age.

alcohol.profile.label: Declared tasting profile
alcohol.profile.guidance: Merchant/producer descriptors, separate from guaranteed specifications.

food.ingredients.label: Ingredients and declared allergens
food.ingredients.guidance: Capture available ingredients, allergen and cross-contact information with source; unknown is explicit, never an allergen-free claim.

food.portion.label: Portion, serving size or pack quantity
food.portion.guidance: Explicit units or a clearly described portion; distinguish people served from item count.

food.dietary.label: Supported dietary descriptors
food.dietary.guidance: Only merchant-confirmed descriptors; do not infer from ingredients alone.

food.options.label: Required choices and optional additions
food.options.guidance: Define minimum/maximum choices, incompatible options, price effect and availability.

food.handling.label: Storage, freshness and handling
food.handling.guidance: Stock/batch expiry is not a timeless listing fact. Surface applicable label/storage instructions.

dish.cuisine.label: Cuisine and dish style
dish.cuisine.guidance: Useful customer descriptors without forcing every item into a cuisine.

dish.preparation.label: Preparation and serving style
dish.preparation.guidance: Include relevant spice, doneness or preparation choices only when offered.

dish.components.label: Meal and combo contents

requirement.when: when the offering is a combo

dish.components.guidance: Link real included dishes/drinks and substitution constraints.

coffee.base.label: Drink base and preparation method
coffee.base.guidance: Coffee/tea type or actual beverage base.

coffee.size.label: Cup volume or stated serving sizes
coffee.size.guidance: Explicit volume units where known; preserve merchant size labels.

coffee.choices.label: Milk, sweetness, temperature and extras
coffee.choices.guidance: Only supported choices with relevant ingredient/allergen implications.

cake.shape.label: Shape, tiers and dimensions
cake.shape.guidance: Dimensions with units; tiers and servings are separate facts.

cake.servings.label: Expected serving quantity
cake.servings.guidance: Merchant-declared serving guidance and size variants.

cake.flavour.label: Sponge, filling and icing choices
cake.flavour.guidance: Required compatible choices, inclusions and extra charges.

cake.design.label: Design, inscription and approval method
cake.design.guidance: Define public customization choices and private customer input; an upload/request does not confirm production acceptance.

cake.due.label: Production lead time and due-date rules
cake.due.guidance: Exact configured lead time; accepted custom scope and due commitment are separate from generic stock.

packaged_food.brand.label: Brand and exact labelled product
packaged_food.brand.guidance: Identify the actual item and manufacturer where relevant.

packaged_food.net.label: Net quantity and pack count
packaged_food.net.guidance: Explicit mass, volume or count; distinguish drained weight where applicable.

packaged_food.nutrition.label: Declared nutrition and basis
packaged_food.nutrition.guidance: Label-derived values with per-serving or per-100-unit basis and units.

packaged_food.storage.label: Storage and shelf-life guidance
packaged_food.storage.guidance: Perishable batch expiry/freshness belongs to stock/batch data and the actual fulfilment promise.

produce.variety.label: Produce type and variety
produce.variety.guidance: Actual variety when known; no invented origin or organic certification.

produce.grade.label: Grade, ripeness and preparation
produce.grade.guidance: Whole, cut or prepared as actually offered.

produce.sale.label: Loose weight or fixed pack basis
produce.sale.guidance: State estimate versus final weighed quantity and the approved adjustment policy.

produce.origin.label: Declared origin and certification reference
produce.origin.guidance: Show certification only from an authorized verified source.

produce.substitution.label: Substitution and seasonal availability policy
produce.substitution.guidance: Customer choice and acceptance are explicit.

protein.kind.label: Species or product and cut
protein.kind.guidance: Exact fish/meat/product type, cut and preparation.

protein.state.label: Fresh, chilled or frozen state
protein.state.guidance: Actual state with supported temperature handling.

protein.weight.label: Net weight, size grade and count
protein.weight.guidance: Explicit weight/count units and fixed versus weighed basis.

protein.preparation.label: Bone, skin and preparation choices
protein.preparation.guidance: Cleaning, filleting, cutting or other actual options and price effects.

protein.source.label: Declared provenance or certification
protein.source.guidance: Confirmed claims only; traceability evidence stays with its owner.

household.purpose.label: Specific product and intended surfaces/use
household.purpose.guidance: Use label descriptions; do not infer compatible surfaces or performance.

household.contents.label: Pack size, concentration and contents
household.contents.guidance: State refill/concentrate versus ready-to-use and explicit units.

household.warnings.label: Label cautions and storage
household.warnings.guidance: Approved label information; internal hazardous-shipping evidence is separate.

gift.contents.label: Included items and quantities
gift.contents.guidance: Link actual components, size/quantity and possible substitutions.

gift.personalization.label: Message or personalization choices
gift.personalization.guidance: Allowed lengths/formats and proof approval; recipient messages stay private to the order.

gift.occasion.label: Occasion and style descriptors
gift.occasion.guidance: Discovery descriptors, not substitute product specifications.

flowers.varieties.label: Flower varieties and stem quantities
flowers.varieties.guidance: Declared arrangement contents; explicit seasonal substitution policy.

flowers.size.label: Arrangement size and dimensions
flowers.size.guidance: Actual sizes with units or declared stem counts, not only small/large.

flowers.state.label: Fresh, dried or preserved
flowers.state.guidance: Accurate product state and care guidance.

flowers.vase.label: Vase and extras
flowers.vase.guidance: State whether the photographed container is included.

custom.scope.label: Customizable features and limits
custom.scope.guidance: Supported choices, dimensions, materials and compatibility; do not accept arbitrary infeasible configurations.

custom.approval.label: Proof or design approval process
custom.approval.guidance: A submitted design remains pending until the authorized acceptance.

custom.lead_time.label: Production lead time and acceptance
custom.lead_time.guidance: Unknown scope uses quote/assessment; exact deadline is accepted separately.

beauty_service.technique.label: Treatment, technique and target area
beauty_service.technique.guidance: Describe the actual service without generated clinical or efficacy claims.

beauty_service.choices.label: Length, style, finish or treatment options

beauty_service.included.label: Products, materials and preparation included
beauty_service.included.guidance: State whether extensions, products or removal are included.

beauty_service.requirements.label: Preparation or consultation requirement
beauty_service.requirements.guidance: Use approved provider instructions; personal suitability information goes to private intake.

cosmetic.finish.label: Finish, coverage and formulation
cosmetic.finish.guidance: Appropriate to the actual makeup/skincare/hair product type.

cosmetic.shade.label: Shades and undertones
cosmetic.shade.guidance: Variant-specific image and actual shade name/code.

cosmetic.suitability.label: Labelled skin or hair type
cosmetic.suitability.guidance: Manufacturer descriptors, not personalized medical advice or guaranteed outcome.

fragrance.notes.label: Declared fragrance family and notes
fragrance.notes.guidance: Producer/merchant descriptors rather than guaranteed wear duration.

fragrance.format.label: Volume, refill and set contents
fragrance.format.guidance: Distinguish tester, full bottle, refill and gift set contents.

durable.brand.label: Brand, manufacturer and model
durable.brand.guidance: Exact model and relevant manufacturer identifiers; internal serial numbers are separate.

durable.dimensions.label: Product dimensions and weight

requirement.when: when needed for fit, delivery or installation

durable.dimensions.guidance: Explicit length/mass units and orientation; packaged dimensions remain distinguishable.

durable.materials.label: Materials, finish and colour
durable.materials.guidance: Actual materials and finish rather than a photograph-derived guess.

durable.contents.label: Included components and accessories
durable.contents.guidance: Separate pictured props and optional accessories from included contents.

durable.warranty.label: Warranty and support details

requirement.when: when a warranty or support is offered

durable.warranty.guidance: Provider, duration, scope and exclusions from the actual terms; a warranty does not establish authenticity.

furniture.kind.label: Furniture type and configuration
furniture.kind.guidance: Specific item, set contents and actual purchasable configuration.

furniture.dimensions.label: Assembled dimensions and access requirements
furniture.dimensions.guidance: Include orientation, relevant seat/bed/shelf dimensions and door/access constraints with units.

furniture.capacity.label: Seating, mattress fit or stated load
furniture.capacity.guidance: Identify the meaning/unit and use confirmed manufacturer values.

furniture.finish.label: Upholstery, finish and assembly options
furniture.finish.guidance: Variant-specific photos, dimensions and charges; custom manufacture is a separate supported activity.

furniture.assembly.label: Assembly, installation and delivery scope
furniture.assembly.guidance: State what is included and link a separately offered installation service where applicable.

textile.kind.label: Item and set contents
textile.kind.guidance: Duvet cover, curtain, towel or actual product; included pieces are explicit.

textile.measurements.label: Dimensions and fit
textile.measurements.guidance: Length/width, curtain drop, mattress depth or applicable measurements with units.

appliance.capacity.label: Rated capacity and relevant output
appliance.capacity.guidance: Units specific to appliance type, such as volume, mass/load or rated output.

appliance.power.label: Voltage, power, plug and supply requirements
appliance.power.guidance: Use manufacturer ratings and explicit units; electrical compatibility is not inferred.

appliance.energy.label: Published energy/noise ratings
appliance.energy.guidance: Preserve source, method/scale and units; do not compare incompatible scales.

appliance.installation.label: Connections, clearance and installation needs
appliance.installation.guidance: Separate product requirements from a bookable installation service.

kitchenware.size.label: Dimensions, capacity and item count
kitchenware.size.guidance: Explicit length/volume units and number of pieces.

kitchenware.material.label: Material, coating and finish
kitchenware.material.guidance: Actual material, coating and relevant care information.

kitchenware.compatibility.label: Heat-source and care compatibility
kitchenware.compatibility.guidance: Only manufacturer-confirmed oven, hob or cleaning compatibility.

book.title.label: Title, author and publisher
book.title.guidance: Exact work, author and publisher where available.

book.edition.label: Edition, publication date and identifier
book.edition.guidance: Preserve ISBN/edition; do not combine different editions in one indistinguishable variant.

book.format.label: Format, language and page count
book.format.guidance: Hardback, paperback or licensed digital format; digital rights/fulfilment need explicit support.

book.genre.label: Genre and audience information
book.genre.guidance: Publisher or merchant descriptors and actual contents guidance.

stationery.kind.label: Specific item and purpose
stationery.kind.guidance: Pen, paper, file, ink or actual supply type.

stationery.size.label: Dimensions, format and pack count
stationery.size.guidance: Paper dimensions, sheet count, ruling or instrument width with units as applicable.

stationery.materials.label: Material, colour and specification
stationery.materials.guidance: Paper grammage, ink properties or actual product specifications with units.

stationery.compatibility.label: Compatible device or refill system
stationery.compatibility.guidance: Exact supported model or refill references.

device.model.label: Exact model, generation and condition grade
device.model.guidance: Condition details supplement the shared product condition; do not hide refurbishment.

device.processor.label: Processor and platform
device.processor.guidance: Actual chip/OS/architecture information; clarify version and compatibility limits.

device.memory.label: Memory and storage options
device.memory.guidance: RAM and storage are different fields in the value structure, each with units and actual variant combinations.

device.display.label: Display size, resolution and panel

requirement.when: when the device has a display

device.display.guidance: Diagonal unit, resolution, refresh rate and actual panel information.

device.connectivity.label: Ports, networks and compatibility
device.connectivity.guidance: Actual connectors and supported standards; no inferred regional/network compatibility.

device.battery.label: Battery and charging specifications
device.battery.guidance: Rated capacity, charging connector and manufacturer ratings; no invented runtime.

phone.network.label: SIM, eSIM and network model
phone.network.guidance: Exact supported configuration and carrier/region restrictions where present.

phone.cameras.label: Camera specifications
phone.cameras.guidance: Preserve lens/sensor distinctions and labelled units.

phone.condition.label: Refurbished battery/repair condition
phone.condition.guidance: Disclosed actual condition; serial/IMEI stays internal unless separately authorized.

computer.graphics.label: Graphics and upgrade options
computer.graphics.guidance: Actual integrated/discrete configuration; upgrading is a separate offered service if relevant.

computer.compatibility.label: Expansion and software licence scope
computer.compatibility.guidance: Do not promise unsupported upgrades or include unlicensed software.

accessory_tech.kind.label: Accessory type and intended device
accessory_tech.kind.guidance: Cable, charger, case, screen protector, peripheral or actual item.

accessory_tech.compatibility.label: Supported device models and protocols
accessory_tech.compatibility.guidance: Exact fit, connectors, power/data protocol and source of compatibility.

accessory_tech.rating.label: Dimensions, length and rated electrical/data capacity
accessory_tech.rating.guidance: Named measurements with units and confirmed ratings; distinguish power capacity from energy capacity.

gaming.platform.label: Platform, generation and region
gaming.platform.guidance: Console generation and relevant region/version restrictions.

gaming.edition.label: Edition, media format and contents
gaming.edition.guidance: Physical/digital, game versus hardware, included DLC/parts; digital delivery needs supported rights.

gaming.compatibility.label: Controller, account and online requirements
gaming.compatibility.guidance: Subscription requirements and compatibility are explicit; account secrets never public.

gaming.rating.label: Published content classification
gaming.rating.guidance: Source classification, not a generated age judgement.

audio.format.label: Headphone, speaker or audio equipment type
audio.format.guidance: Actual form factor and intended connection method.

audio.ratings.label: Power, impedance and other published ratings
audio.ratings.guidance: Use labelled measures and units; never equate unlike power-rating methods.

audio.features.label: Microphone, noise control and battery features
audio.features.guidance: Exact product features and confirmed ratings.

smart.ecosystem.label: Supported hubs, apps and ecosystems
smart.ecosystem.guidance: Local/cloud and account requirements, regional support and compatibility limits.

smart.network.label: Network, power and installation requirements
smart.network.guidance: Explicit supported band/protocol, supply and mounting requirements.

smart.subscription.label: Ongoing fees and privacy-related features
smart.subscription.guidance: Declare recurring fees, storage and supported features; do not collect credentials in listing fields.

telecom.network.label: Provider and exact plan/device
telecom.network.guidance: Identify the provider, product and any provider confirmation needed.

telecom.allowance.label: Data, call or service allowance
telecom.allowance.guidance: Exact units, validity period, limits and expiry; unlimited requires its actual fair-use terms.

telecom.eligibility.label: Coverage and compatibility requirements
telecom.eligibility.guidance: Availability comes from the provider for the actual customer location/device.

telecom.activation.label: Activation process and recurring charges
telecom.activation.guidance: Disclose activation versus confirmed service and applicable ongoing fees; private identity inputs use authorized provider flow.

repair.equipment.label: Supported product, model or vehicle
repair.equipment.guidance: Compatibility determines the task; do not imply support for every model.

repair.assessment.label: Assessment, diagnostics and quoted work
repair.assessment.guidance: Separate diagnostic fee, estimate and later authorized repair.

repair.parts.label: Parts, labour, warranty and exclusions
repair.parts.guidance: Actual approved work and parts acceptance; a diagnostic listing is not a final repair price.

repair.turnaround.label: Turnaround estimate and intake method
repair.turnaround.guidance: Assessment-required is explicit; intake appointments and the whole job are distinct.

medicine.identity.label: Exact product and manufacturer
medicine.identity.guidance: Approved/labelled product identity; do not generate medical alternatives.

medicine.form.label: Form, labelled strength and pack quantity
medicine.form.guidance: Separate strength, dosage form and quantity with units; these are label facts, not dosage instructions.

medicine.eligibility.label: Applicable dispensing and verification policy
medicine.eligibility.guidance: Authorized policy determines checks; no legal classification is invented by this plan.

medicine.information.label: Approved label information and storage
medicine.information.guidance: Display authoritative approved content; no generated treatment guidance.

medical_supply.purpose.label: Device or supply type and labelled use
medical_supply.purpose.guidance: Manufacturer-stated purpose; no personalized clinical recommendation.

medical_supply.size.label: Sizes, dimensions, units and pack contents
medical_supply.size.guidance: Consumable sizes and device sizes need explicit measurement units.

medical_supply.compatibility.label: Compatibility, sterility and use conditions
medical_supply.compatibility.guidance: Capture actual manufacturer labels and compatible models; unknown is not sterile or reusable.

medical_supply.evidence.label: Required product verification reference
medical_supply.evidence.guidance: No seller-created verification badge or regulatory approval.

baby.kind.label: Specific baby product type
baby.kind.guidance: Diaper, feeding item, care product, food or equipment uses its actual additional template.

baby.fit.label: Labelled age, weight or size range
baby.fit.guidance: Preserve label basis and units; these are product descriptors, not clinical advice.

baby.material.label: Materials, compatibility and pack contents
baby.material.guidance: Actual manufacturer information; no invented safety claims.

supplement.ingredients.label: Labelled ingredients and amount basis
supplement.ingredients.guidance: Separate amount per serving/unit from recommended use; no generated dosage advice.

supplement.form.label: Product form, net quantity and servings
supplement.form.guidance: Capsule/powder/liquid as labelled, with units and actual contents.

supplement.claims.label: Approved label information and cautions
supplement.claims.guidance: Do not infer medical benefits or suitability; source approved wording and policy.

health_service.service.label: Service name, scope and provider specialty
health_service.service.guidance: Public service description rather than a patient's symptoms or diagnosis.

health_service.provider.label: Public professional profile and verification reference

requirement.when: when a named practitioner is offered

health_service.provider.guidance: Use approved public projection and verification owner, never infer professional authorization from a category.

health_service.preparation.label: Approved preparation and result-delivery information
health_service.preparation.guidance: Provider-approved administrative content; clinical records/results use their authorized private system.

lab.test.label: Test or panel identity and included tests
lab.test.guidance: Accurate service scope; no generated interpretation or substitute test advice.

lab.collection.label: Sample and supported collection method
lab.collection.guidance: Provider-approved sample information and venue/home-collection capability.

lab.turnaround.label: Published result turnaround basis
lab.turnaround.guidance: Label estimated versus confirmed; results stay private outside the public catalog.

health_intake.contact.label: Necessary patient contact and booking identity
health_intake.contact.guidance: Purpose-limited authorized collection; not part of a public listing or ordinary merchant notes.

health_intake.requirements.label: Necessary referral or administrative documents

requirement.when: when required by the authorized provider

health_intake.requirements.guidance: Do not collect clinical history by default. Existing clinical authority owns any sensitive records.

rental.identity.label: Exact vehicle or vehicle class
rental.identity.guidance: Explicit guaranteed vehicle versus class/or-similar policy; identified allocations remain resource-owned.

rental.make.label: Make, model, year or class description
rental.make.guidance: Use actual vehicle details; a class listing must disclose which specifications are guaranteed.

rental.seats.label: Passenger seats and luggage capacity
rental.seats.guidance: Separate people from bags; count/unit and luggage assumptions are explicit.

rental.transmission.label: Transmission and fuel/power type
rental.transmission.guidance: Actual guaranteed configuration or transparent class alternatives.

rental.features.label: Air conditioning and equipment
rental.features.guidance: Actual confirmed features; never infer off-road capability.

rental.mileage.label: Distance allowance and excess-distance charge
rental.mileage.guidance: Unlimited or exact allowance with km/mi and per-day/per-rental basis; excess charge is separately priced.

rental.fuel.label: Fuel or charging return policy
rental.fuel.guidance: State actual pickup/return obligation and applicable costs.

rental.deposit.label: Deposit and release conditions
rental.deposit.guidance: Explicit amount/currency or calculation, timing and authorized refund/release policy.

rental.cover.label: Included cover and exclusions
rental.cover.guidance: Approved terms and responsibility limits; no invented insurance or legal eligibility thresholds.

rental.eligibility.label: Driver, use and travel restrictions
rental.eligibility.guidance: Actual accepted driver/document, territory and vehicle-use terms from the policy owner; customer documents use private authorized intake.

rental.driver.label: Self-drive or optional driver
rental.driver.guidance: Driver selection changes price and required joint allocation; it does not convert the rental to a transfer.

rental.period.label: Rental duration and pickup/return rules
rental.period.guidance: Exact minimum/maximum, charge period, grace/late rules and time/date semantics.

rental.handover.label: Pickup and return places and charges
rental.handover.guidance: Supported places and time constraints; travel fees must be explicit.

rental_long.billing.label: Billing period, commitment and usage limits
rental_long.billing.guidance: Renewal/extension needs explicit consent; contract dates are not implicit recurring bookings.

rental_long.support.label: Maintenance, replacement and support scope
rental_long.support.guidance: Only actual contractual inclusions and response commitments.

rental_long.corporate.label: Business account requirements

requirement.when: when a business account is needed

rental_long.corporate.guidance: Private account documents are collected through an authorized intake.

bike.kind.label: Bike type, model and fit
bike.kind.guidance: Distinguish bicycle, e-bike and motorcycle; describe rider fit with explicit measurements where relevant.

bike.power.label: Engine or battery specifications
bike.power.guidance: Manufacturer-labelled units and actual range assumptions, not guessed runtime.

bike.equipment.label: Included helmet, locks and equipment
bike.equipment.guidance: Actual included equipment and additional charges.

bike.terms.label: Rental eligibility, deposit and return rules
bike.terms.guidance: Applicable merchant terms and exact interval; no universal age/licence threshold is set here.

bike.usage.label: Fuel, charging and distance policy

requirement.when: when a powered bike is rented

bike.usage.guidance: Actual fuel/charging return policy, distance allowance and applicable excess charges.

transfer.route.label: Airports, origin/destination zones and route basis
transfer.route.guidance: Fixed route versus distance/time-priced scope is explicit.

transfer.vehicle.label: Vehicle class, seats and luggage
transfer.vehicle.guidance: Separate seat/bag capacity and guaranteed vehicle from or-similar class.

transfer.included.label: Waiting, parking, tolls and extra stops
transfer.included.guidance: Included quantities/time and additional charge basis.

transfer.meeting.label: Meeting point and flight-delay policy

requirement.when: when airport or assisted meeting is offered

transfer.meeting.guidance: Exact instructions; flight tracking is a configured capability, not an assumed live connection.

transfer.accessibility.label: Child seats and accessibility options
transfer.accessibility.guidance: Availability and suitability confirmed for actual requested resources.

greeting.scope.label: Greeting area, escort scope and assistance
greeting.scope.guidance: Greeter-only service is separate from a vehicle transfer.

greeting.waiting.label: Included waiting and extra-time policy
greeting.waiting.guidance: Exact time allowance and charge basis.

greeting.sign.label: Meeting-sign options
greeting.sign.guidance: Customer name/sign content is private to the booking and restricted execution view.

trip_intake.route.label: Chosen pickup and destination

requirement.when: when a trip or handover requires it

trip_intake.route.guidance: Private exact address/access details; confirm actual coverage.

trip_intake.time.label: Travel or rental start/end
trip_intake.time.guidance: Kenya display; explicit instants versus local dates, valid start/end and relevant buffers.

trip_intake.party.label: Passengers, luggage and extras
trip_intake.party.guidance: Validate actual capacity and compatible child/accessibility requests.

trip_intake.flight.label: Flight and passenger details
trip_intake.flight.guidance: Necessary trip information only; provider confirmation and flight-feed connection are separate.

event.programme.label: Event programme and organizer
event.programme.guidance: Actual performer/programme and organizer references; never imply organizer verification from seller input.

event.venue.label: Venue, access and accessibility
event.venue.guidance: Public venue projection; attendee personal details remain private.

event.occurrences.label: Actual dated performances or sessions
event.occurrences.guidance: Start/end, admission window, Kenya time and authoritative capacity per occurrence.

event.tiers.label: Ticket types, inclusions and quantity rules
event.tiers.guidance: Actual tiers, seating/zone rules and linked shared capacity; booking is separate from ticket issuance.

event.admission.label: Entry, transfer and cancellation policy
event.admission.guidance: Approved applicable terms including restrictions; no invented thresholds.

session.activity.label: Activity, curriculum and level
session.activity.guidance: Describe actual content, level and intended audience.

session.format.label: Venue, format and instructor
session.format.guidance: Actual venue/remote format and authorized public instructor profile.

session.duration.label: Session duration and occurrence pattern
session.duration.guidance: Exact duration and dated occurrences; recurring dates do not create a membership.

session.capacity.label: Group size and place allocation
session.capacity.guidance: Actual shared session capacity, booking quantities and private/group distinction.

session.equipment.label: Included equipment and customer prerequisites
session.equipment.guidance: Actual supplied items and approved requirements; personal suitability data remains private.

photography.style.label: Shoot type, style and location options
photography.style.guidance: Portrait, event, product or actual scope.

photography.duration.label: Shoot time and coverage
photography.duration.guidance: Exact time basis; travel/setup requirements are separately configured.

photography.deliverables.label: Image count, editing and delivery format
photography.deliverables.guidance: Distinguish selected/edited/raw files, resolution and actual output.

photography.rights.label: Usage rights, turnaround and revisions
photography.rights.guidance: Actual contracted rights and delivery estimate; private image permissions are separate.

event_service.kind.label: Event type and package scope
event_service.kind.guidance: Planning/coordination, venue sourcing or a specific venue offer are different choices.

event_service.size.label: Guest range and supported locations
event_service.size.guidance: Guest count is intake, not proof that a venue or supplier is reserved.

event_service.suppliers.label: Included suppliers and deliverables
event_service.suppliers.guidance: Clearly state excluded vendor charges and supplier confirmation dependencies.

event_service.acceptance.label: Quote, approval and change process
event_service.acceptance.guidance: A request does not reserve supplier capacity or confirm an event.

space.space.label: Space type and compatible party size
space.space.guidance: Actual eligible tables/spaces; compatible combinations require real allocation rules.

space.occupancy.label: Duration, turnover and seating rules
space.occupancy.guidance: Exact configured occupancy and buffers; existing reservation software is not enabling intent.

space.terms.label: Deposit, minimum spend and cancellation terms
space.terms.guidance: Only applicable reviewed terms; no automatic food order from a space reservation.

membership.entitlement.label: Included benefits, quantities and exclusions
membership.entitlement.guidance: Define access/credits/deliveries and redemption units; enrollment does not reserve a session.

membership.validity.label: Term, validity and redemption rules
membership.validity.guidance: Exact local dates or duration and usage limits; unused credits and expiry are explicit.

membership.renewal.label: Renewal, cancellation and recurring payment consent
membership.renewal.guidance: Recurring schedule, entitlement and recurring charge consent are separate facts.

membership.booking.label: Separate booking or delivery requirements

requirement.when: when benefits need reservations or fulfilment

membership.booking.guidance: The actual session/order/visit needs its own supported workflow and capacity check.

tour.itinerary.label: Itinerary, stops and activity schedule
tour.itinerary.guidance: Dated/local-date milestones, journey time and actual included activities.

tour.duration.label: Duration, nights and departure options
tour.duration.guidance: Separate elapsed duration, local nights and departure dates.

tour.party.label: Private/shared format and party limits
tour.party.guidance: Price basis per person/group and actual controlled or supplier capacity.

tour.inclusions.label: Guide, meals, accommodation, transport and fees
tour.inclusions.guidance: Explicit inclusions/exclusions; named lodging and flight inventory require authority confirmation.

tour.requirements.label: Access, language, equipment and conditions
tour.requirements.guidance: Actual languages and merchant/provider-approved requirements; no invented travel or clinical advice.

tour.supplier.label: Confirmation and change policy
tour.supplier.guidance: Supplier enquiry is not instant confirmation; cancellation and substitutions use accepted terms.

cleaning.tasks.label: Included tasks, surfaces and exclusions
cleaning.tasks.guidance: Standard/deep/specialist tasks need explicit scope and possible assessment.

cleaning.quantity.label: Rooms, area, workload and team basis
cleaning.quantity.guidance: Explicit m2/ft2, rooms or time basis; do not equate area with duration without an actual model.

cleaning.supplies.label: Equipment, products and customer requirements
cleaning.supplies.guidance: State supplied products/equipment and necessary access/services.

cleaning.completion.label: Visit, assessment and completion method
cleaning.completion.guidance: Unknown workload uses assessment; actual team/travel capacity gates confirmation.

laundry.items.label: Accepted item types and care categories
laundry.items.guidance: Per piece/kg/volume basis and exact units; garment-specific restrictions apply.

laundry.scope.label: Wash, dry, press and treatment inclusions
laundry.scope.guidance: Actual processing methods and relevant label restrictions.

laundry.turnaround.label: Turnaround and express choices
laundry.turnaround.guidance: A collection promise does not establish a feasible return promise.

laundry.inspection.label: Assessment, stain treatment and damage policy
laundry.inspection.guidance: Final counted/weighed scope and any revised price require the approved acceptance flow.

laundry.windows.label: Collection, processing and return constraints
laundry.windows.guidance: Use compatible paired capacity and workload; unknown quantities cannot produce a firm return date.

vehicle_job.vehicle.label: Supported vehicle types and fitment
vehicle_job.vehicle.guidance: Actual fitment and variant details; customer vehicle identifiers belong in private intake.

vehicle_job.package.label: Service tasks and exclusions
vehicle_job.package.guidance: Actual service package, parts/consumables and assessment scope.

vehicle_job.location.label: Workshop, mobile or roadside method
vehicle_job.location.guidance: Method selects the applicable job/visit/appointment model; coverage is separately authoritative.

vehicle_job.duration.label: Duration or diagnostic estimate
vehicle_job.duration.guidance: Do not block the whole uncertain repair as a fixed appointment.

tire.size.label: Tyre dimensions and size designation
tire.size.guidance: Preserve exact width/aspect/rim designation and units; do not infer vehicle compatibility.

tire.rating.label: Load, speed and condition specification
tire.rating.guidance: Manufacturer ratings and actual condition; no inferred safety suitability.

tire.fitment.label: Compatible fitment and fitting inclusion
tire.fitment.guidance: Tyre purchase and fitting service have separate owners/prices and supported workflows.

battery.rating.label: Voltage, capacity and start-rating specification
battery.rating.guidance: Use named rating methods/units and actual model; do not equate unlike start-rating methods.

battery.fitment.label: Dimensions, terminals and compatible models
battery.fitment.guidance: Explicit compatibility source, orientation and dimensions.

battery.service.label: Installation, exchange and warranty terms
battery.service.guidance: Old-battery/core exchange and diagnostic/installation charges need clear acceptance.

assistance.scope.label: Supported incident or inspection scope
assistance.scope.guidance: Towing, jump-start, recovery or inspection are separate selectable tasks.

assistance.limits.label: Vehicle, distance and operating limits
assistance.limits.guidance: Applicable vehicle constraints, included distance and extra charges with units.

assistance.response.label: Response estimate and acceptance method
assistance.response.guidance: Estimate versus actual dispatch confirmation is explicit; 24-hour claim is not current resource availability.

assistance.report.label: Deliverables and report scope
assistance.report.guidance: State what is checked and delivered without inventing certification or statutory approval.

financial.provider.label: Provider and service identity
financial.provider.guidance: Only an authorized public provider profile and verification projection.

financial.scope.label: Service purpose and supported channels
financial.scope.guidance: Information/enquiry/appointment/handoff scope is explicit; no transaction authority is granted by a listing.

financial.terms.label: Provider-approved fees, rates and eligibility reference
financial.terms.guidance: Source, effective time, expiry and indicative versus executable status; no invented rate, advice or guarantee.

financial.handoff.label: Application, quote or provider handoff process
financial.handoff.guidance: Sensitive identity/payment information stays in the authorized provider flow.

financial_scope.products.label: Supported service or product types
financial_scope.products.guidance: Account/enquiry, currency pair, cover type, payment channel, remittance corridor, membership or business service as applicable.

financial_scope.coverage.label: Locations, currencies or corridor limits
financial_scope.coverage.guidance: Only provider-confirmed scope; availability and live pricing must be checked at the provider.

coordination.task.label: Specific task and deliverables
coordination.task.guidance: Define what the coordinator does versus the supplier's actual service.

coordination.limits.label: Included effort, response window and exclusions
coordination.limits.guidance: Response estimate is not supplier or execution confirmation.

coordination.approval.label: Budget, purchase and supplier approval process
coordination.approval.guidance: Customer authorization precedes actual spending/commitment; third-party costs and coordination fees remain separate.

coordination.privacy.label: Required private request information
coordination.privacy.guidance: Only purpose-appropriate customer information; keys/access codes/passports are not public listing fields.

moving.scope.label: Move type and included packing/handling
moving.scope.guidance: Coordination-only versus actual transport is explicit.

moving.load.label: Inventory, load volume and handling limits
moving.load.guidance: Public service limits with units; actual household item list belongs to private request.

moving.access.label: Access, floor, lift and route factors
moving.access.guidance: Private origin/destination/access information determines quoted scope.

moving.terms.label: Valuation, cover and damage terms
moving.terms.guidance: Approved actual terms and acceptance; no implied insurance from a merchant category.

freight.route.label: Supported origin, destination and legs
freight.route.guidance: Port/airport/door scope and included road/warehouse legs are explicit.

freight.cargo.label: Cargo classes, restrictions and handling
freight.cargo.guidance: Merchant/carrier-approved scope; no invented customs, hazardous-goods or legal clearance.

freight.units.label: Chargeable weight, volume or container basis
freight.units.guidance: kg, m3/CBM or container type, minimums and actual carrier conversion rule; never invent a volumetric divisor.

freight.inclusions.label: Transit estimate, clearance and charge inclusions
freight.inclusions.guidance: Dates/estimates, duties/taxes/handling exclusions and insurance scope must be explicit.

freight.acceptance.label: Quote validity and carrier confirmation
freight.acceptance.guidance: A request is not accepted cargo or confirmed freight capacity.

cargo_intake.goods.label: Goods, piece count and declared value
cargo_intake.goods.guidance: Purpose-limited declaration with actual currency; carrier review determines acceptance.

cargo_intake.dimensions.label: Dimensions, mass and unit per piece
cargo_intake.dimensions.guidance: Length/width/height and gross mass with units; totals do not replace per-piece constraints.

cargo_intake.route.label: Collection, delivery and required dates
cargo_intake.route.guidance: Exact private addresses, sender/recipient contacts and access needs are restricted.

cargo_intake.documents.label: Applicable carrier/customs document references

requirement.when: when required by the accepted service

cargo_intake.documents.guidance: Only authorized document flow; source requirements from the applicable carrier/policy.

storage.unit.label: Storage type, dimensions and capacity unit
storage.unit.guidance: Pallet, bay, unit, m2/ft2 or m3 with dimensions and height where relevant; area is not volume.

storage.goods.label: Accepted goods and environment
storage.goods.guidance: Temperature/humidity or other controls only if actually supported; declared restrictions and compatibility.

storage.period.label: Occupancy, billing and access rules
storage.period.guidance: Exact period, minimum term and intake/release policy; custody and allocation remain distinct.

storage.handling.label: Receiving, picking, dispatch and cover scope
storage.handling.guidance: Included handling quantities and charges; no inferred warehouse insurance or stock transfer.

storage.availability.label: Actual compatible unit/capacity source
storage.availability.guidance: Actual authoritative capacity, not total warehouse area as a promise of free space.

pizza.size.label: Pizza diameter and portions
pizza.size.guidance: Explicit units; slices and intended servings are separately labelled.

pizza.base.label: Crust, base and topping choices
pizza.base.guidance: Included toppings, extra selections, half-and-half rules and incompatible choices if supported.

bakery.kind.label: Item, flavour and filling
bakery.kind.guidance: Actual pastry/bread/dessert identity, filling and icing where relevant.

bakery.size.label: Piece dimensions, weight or serving format
bakery.size.guidance: Explicit units and pack count; whole item versus slice is clear.

bakery.choices.label: Toppings, temperature and serving options
bakery.choices.guidance: Frozen desserts need actual scoop/volume basis and relevant cold fulfilment.

wellness.modality.label: Session modality, focus and intensity description
wellness.modality.guidance: Actual provider description; no invented efficacy or health suitability claims.

wellness.inclusions.label: Facilities, products and equipment included
wellness.inclusions.guidance: Distinguish facility access, individual service and paid extras.

wellness.preferences.label: Supported provider and format preferences
wellness.preferences.guidance: Preferences require actual resource availability; personal suitability data uses private intake.

installation.compatibility.label: Supported items, site and connections
installation.compatibility.guidance: Exact supported product/site requirements and any pre-visit assessment.

installation.scope.label: Included labour, materials and exclusions
installation.scope.guidance: Required parts, mounting or disposal charges are explicit.

installation.handover.label: Testing, handover and support scope
installation.handover.guidance: State actual acceptance and support without inventing certification.

garment_scope.construction.label: Garment construction
garment_scope.construction.guidance: Upper body, lower body, dress/full-body or explicitly listed set. This selects relevant measurement groups.

garment_scope.pieces.label: Included garments and size selection

requirement.when: when a set or coordinated outfit is sold

garment_scope.pieces.guidance: Keep each piece's fit chart and valid set combinations; a jacket size does not determine a trouser size.

fitted_underwear.kind.label: Actual garment type
fitted_underwear.kind.guidance: Brief, bra, bodysuit or other actual construction selects the relevant fit fields.

fitted_underwear.band.label: Underbust or band measurement and system

requirement.when: when a band-sized garment is sold

fitted_underwear.band.guidance: State unit, body/garment basis and the merchant's named system.

fitted_underwear.cup.label: Cup labels and bust fit guidance
fitted_underwear.cup.guidance: Cup systems are not universally equivalent; link actual band/cup combinations and known guidance.

fitted_underwear.bust.label: Bust range by actual band/cup combination
fitted_underwear.bust.guidance: Explicit units and measurement basis; never calculate a cup from an unverified conversion.

fitted_underwear.waist_hips.label: Waist and hip fit by size

requirement.when: when a lower-body garment is sold

fitted_underwear.waist_hips.guidance: Separate waist and hips, units and basis; record actual combination-specific values.

cable.ends.label: Connector at each end
cable.ends.guidance: Exact connector types/gender and relevant protocol/version.

cable.ratings.label: Supported power, data and video specifications
cable.ratings.guidance: Named actual manufacturer-supported rates and units; connector shape alone does not imply a capability.

charger.input.label: Input voltage, frequency and plug
charger.input.guidance: Actual input ratings and plug type.

charger.outputs.label: Port output profiles and shared-power limit
charger.outputs.guidance: Per-port voltage/current/power and charging protocol; distinguish combined maximum from per-port maximum.

charger.contents.label: Included cable and compatible protocols
charger.contents.guidance: A cable is included only when explicitly stated; source compatibility rather than guessing.

powerbank.capacity.label: Rated capacity and measurement basis
powerbank.capacity.guidance: mAh/Wh with rated voltage where needed; distinguish cell capacity from delivered output and never invent runtime.

powerbank.ports.label: Input/output profiles and supported protocols
powerbank.ports.guidance: Actual ports and labelled ratings with units.

powerbank.size.label: Dimensions and weight
powerbank.size.guidance: Explicit units; carrier eligibility remains an applicable policy decision, not a catalog inference.

case.fit.label: Exact compatible device models
case.fit.guidance: Model/generation/size, cutouts and connector/camera clearance where relevant.

case.construction.label: Material, coverage and included pieces
case.construction.guidance: Case, screen protector or other protection type and actual contents.

case.features.label: Mounting, charging and stand compatibility
case.features.guidance: Only confirmed compatibility and product claims.

fashion_identity.brand.label: Brand or maker
fashion_identity.brand.guidance: Named brand, independent maker or explicitly unbranded; never force an invented brand.

fashion_identity.style.label: Style name or collection
fashion_identity.style.guidance: Customer-recognizable style; merchant SKU stays with internal identity.

fashion_identity.audience.label: Intended audience or fit range
fashion_identity.audience.guidance: Merchant-described adult, child or unisex fit; the merchant specialty does not restrict who can buy.

fashion_identity.condition.label: Condition details and disclosed defects
fashion_identity.condition.guidance: Supplement the shared condition value with actual wear/defects and relevant photos.

fashion_identity.photos.label: Colour-specific and detail photos
fashion_identity.photos.guidance: Associate actual colour views and relevant fabric/closure/defect details; do not infer specifications from photographs.

fashion_variants.pattern.label: Pattern or print
fashion_variants.pattern.guidance: Named patterns map to actual variants if the purchased item changes.

fashion_variants.chart.label: Reusable size chart reference and version

requirement.when: when a shared chart is used

fashion_variants.chart.guidance: Explicit accurate chart version; a material chart change previews affected listings.

fashion_variants.measurements.label: Variant-specific measurement overrides

requirement.when: when colour, batch or construction changes fit

fashion_variants.measurements.guidance: Scope each override to actual variant/piece; one size label does not imply identical measurements across all colours or suppliers.

fashion_variants.sku.label: Internal variant SKU or supplier reference
fashion_variants.sku.guidance: Internal reference distinct from public style name; retain stable variant IDs.

fashion_care.silhouette.label: Silhouette or cut
fashion_care.silhouette.guidance: Distinct from fit allowance; examples describe the actual garment rather than guaranteed body fit.

fashion_care.care.label: Washing, drying and ironing guidance
fashion_care.care.guidance: Exact label/merchant instructions; text equivalents accompany any care icons.

fashion_care.finish.label: Construction details and functional features
fashion_care.finish.guidance: Actual pockets, waistband, seams, padding or adjustments; unsupported performance claims are excluded.

bottom_extra.leg_opening.label: Leg opening by size
bottom_extra.leg_opening.guidance: Explicit unit and circumference/flat-width basis; not applicable to a skirt.

bottom_extra.thigh.label: Thigh fit by size
bottom_extra.thigh.guidance: Known measurement/range and method; do not derive it from hip measurement.

bottom_extra.waistband.label: Waistband construction
bottom_extra.waistband.guidance: Fixed, elastic, adjustable or not provided; an adjustable waistband needs its actual known range for fit claims.

dress_extra.length_style.label: Dress length style
dress_extra.length_style.guidance: Mini, midi, maxi or actual merchant descriptor; numeric length remains in the size guide.

dress_extra.adjustments.label: Adjustable straps, waist or other fit features
dress_extra.adjustments.guidance: Explain what adjusts and include a known measurement range rather than promising universal fit.

dress_extra.slit.label: Slit or special construction detail
dress_extra.slit.guidance: Relevant actual design details with measurements where useful.

shoe_extra.shape.label: Toe shape and shoe style
shoe_extra.shape.guidance: Actual footwear shape/style; sizes still use the named system.

shoe_extra.closure.label: Fastening
shoe_extra.closure.guidance: Laces, buckle, zip, slip-on or actual construction.

shoe_extra.fit.label: Merchant fit notes
shoe_extra.fit.guidance: Specific guidance such as width/instep allowance with its source; no automatic size recommendation.

shoe_extra.care.label: Care and material-specific instructions
shoe_extra.care.guidance: Use confirmed product instructions and accessible text.

bag_extra.kind.label: Bag type
bag_extra.kind.guidance: Handbag, backpack, travel bag or actual supported type selects relevant features.

bag_extra.straps.label: Strap drop and adjustable length
