bag_extra.straps.guidance: Named measurement with unit and endpoints; handle drop is not total strap length.

bag_extra.features.label: Compartments, handles, wheels and closure
bag_extra.features.guidance: Only applicable actual features; distinguish included straps/locks from optional extras.

bag_extra.lining.label: Lining and care information
bag_extra.lining.guidance: Actual lining/material and confirmed care instructions.

watch_extra.case_material.label: Case and glass materials
watch_extra.case_material.guidance: Materials are separate from the numeric case dimensions.

watch_extra.strap_material.label: Strap or bracelet material
watch_extra.strap_material.guidance: Identify material, finish and replaceability where known.

watch_extra.wrist.label: Wrist fit range
watch_extra.wrist.guidance: Explicit wrist circumference range/unit and adjustable link/buckle scope.

watch_extra.strap_width.label: Strap width
watch_extra.strap_width.guidance: Known lug/strap width with unit; do not infer replacement compatibility.

watch_extra.care.label: Care, warranty and service information
watch_extra.care.guidance: Confirmed product care; manufacturer rating alone does not imply a safe activity.

smartwatch.model.label: Exact smartwatch model and case version
smartwatch.model.guidance: Actual generation, case dimensions and promised model; not a generic smart-home device.

smartwatch.compatibility.label: Compatible phone systems and required app
smartwatch.compatibility.guidance: Actual supported versions, region/network limits and subscription needs where relevant.

smartwatch.display.label: Display type and size
smartwatch.display.guidance: Actual display dimensions/resolution with units where needed.

smartwatch.battery.label: Battery capacity and charging
smartwatch.battery.guidance: Rated capacity, charging method and included charger; no invented runtime.

smartwatch.features.label: Confirmed connectivity and activity features
smartwatch.features.guidance: Manufacturer-described features; no inferred clinical accuracy or diagnosis.

ring.system.label: Ring size labels and system
ring.system.guidance: Preserve the actual merchant system; no unverified international conversion.

ring.fit.label: Internal diameter or circumference by size
ring.fit.guidance: Exact measurement meaning, unit and actual size row; adjustable rings state a known range.

ring.width.label: Band width and setting dimensions
ring.width.guidance: Separate band width from ring diameter; explicit units.

ring.stone.label: Stone, setting and declared metal specification
ring.stone.guidance: Actual gemstone/plating/metal claims and source; do not infer authenticity or purity.

necklace.length.label: Chain length and adjustment range
necklace.length.guidance: Known chain length with units; do not confuse doubled chain length with wearing drop.

necklace.pendant.label: Pendant dimensions and included pieces
necklace.pendant.guidance: Explicit units and whether a photographed pendant/chain is included.

bracelet.fit.label: Wrist range or item length by size
bracelet.fit.guidance: State body circumference versus item length and unit; adjustable range is explicit.

earring.pieces.label: Single, pair or set contents
earring.pieces.guidance: Actual included piece count; a photo of a pair does not establish that two are sold.

earring.fastening.label: Post, hook, clip or other fastening
earring.fastening.guidance: Actual fastening and material where relevant; no inferred allergy/safety guarantee.

belt.length.label: Belt length or wearer fit by size
belt.length.guidance: Named measurement method, unit and size rows; total strap length differs from buckle-to-hole measurement.

belt.buckle.label: Buckle and closure
belt.buckle.guidance: Actual buckle material/type and whether interchangeable.

hat.circumference.label: Head circumference range by size
hat.circumference.guidance: Body fit range and length unit; one-size requires actual guidance or an explicit not-provided state.

scarf.dimensions.label: Length and width
scarf.dimensions.guidance: Named dimensions and unit; distinguish fringe from body length where relevant.

scarf.finish.label: Edges, fringe and construction
scarf.finish.guidance: Actual product construction and included pieces.

tailoring.task.label: Made-to-measure, alteration or garment task
tailoring.task.guidance: Choose the actual garment and supported task; an assessment may precede price/due acceptance.

tailoring.materials.label: Who supplies fabric and materials
tailoring.materials.guidance: Merchant-supplied, customer-supplied or agreed after assessment; state inclusions and extra charges.

tailoring.measurement_method.label: Measurement or fitting method
tailoring.measurement_method.guidance: In-person fitting, submitted measurements or reference garment only if actually supported.

tailoring.fittings.label: Included fittings, revisions and acceptance
tailoring.fittings.guidance: Appointment scheduling is separately configured; do not invent a confirmed fitting from a production request.

fashion_intake.measurements.label: Customer's personal measurements

requirement.when: when necessary for the selected tailoring task

fashion_intake.measurements.guidance: Private transaction data with explicit body/garment basis and units; never publish as a product size chart.

fashion_intake.design.label: Customer design, garment or reference files

requirement.when: when needed to agree the work

fashion_intake.design.guidance: Private purpose-limited attachments and approval; no raw personal files on public product pages.

wine_specs.grapes.label: Grape varieties or blend

requirement.when: when supplied on the product information

wine_specs.grapes.guidance: Actual producer information; unknown varieties are not inferred from region.

wine_specs.sweetness.label: Declared sweetness or style
wine_specs.sweetness.guidance: Producer/merchant descriptor, separate from vintage, ABV and exact bottle volume.

wine_specs.closure.label: Bottle closure and packaging
wine_specs.closure.guidance: Actual closure and case contents; gift wrapping remains an option with its own charge.

spirit_specs.category.label: Spirit category and expression
spirit_specs.category.guidance: Exact labelled type and expression; separate from brand and bottle size.

spirit_specs.age.label: Labelled age or maturation statement

requirement.when: when an age or maturation claim is made

spirit_specs.age.guidance: Use the actual label/source rather than a generated product claim.

spirit_specs.flavour.label: Flavoured, blended or other declared style

mixer_specs.flavour.label: Flavour and actual drink base
mixer_specs.flavour.guidance: Actual ingredients/base and named flavour, not inferred dietary or wellness claims.

mixer_specs.format.label: Ready-to-drink, concentrate or syrup
mixer_specs.format.guidance: State exact product form and label instructions where supplied; never invent dilution instructions.

mixer_specs.sweetener.label: Declared sugar/sweetener information
mixer_specs.sweetener.guidance: Source-backed label facts, separate from an unverified sugar-free claim.

tobacco_specs.variant.label: Exact manufacturer variant and format
tobacco_specs.variant.guidance: Preserve actual labelled identity, pack count and applicable warnings.

tobacco_specs.cigar.label: Cigar shape and labelled dimensions

requirement.when: when a cigar format is sold

tobacco_specs.cigar.guidance: Named length/ring-gauge system, wrapper/origin information if supplied; no guessed conversion or health comparison.

cosmetic_specs.kind.label: Exact product kind and application area
cosmetic_specs.kind.guidance: Foundation, lip product, eye product or actual registered kind; select the applicable shade/finish fields.

cosmetic_specs.undertone.label: Labelled undertone or shade reference

requirement.when: when relevant to the product shade

cosmetic_specs.undertone.guidance: Actual manufacturer shade/code; images and variants refer to the same product.

cosmetic_specs.format.label: Cream, liquid, powder, stick or actual form
cosmetic_specs.format.guidance: Formulation format and net quantity are separate facts.

care_specs.kind.label: Exact care product type
care_specs.kind.guidance: Shampoo, conditioner, serum, cleanser or actual product kind rather than the shop's category.

care_specs.formula.label: Labelled formulation and ingredient details
care_specs.formula.guidance: Known ingredient amounts, fragrance/form and relevant label descriptors; no generated efficacy or treatment advice.

care_specs.use.label: Labelled hair/skin descriptors and instructions
care_specs.use.guidance: Do not turn a product descriptor into a personal suitability judgement.

vehicle_specs.make.label: Vehicle make and model

requirement.when: when a specific model is promised

vehicle_specs.make.guidance: Exact actual make/model; a class offer states which features are guaranteed versus alternatives.

vehicle_specs.year.label: Model year or declared vehicle age information
vehicle_specs.year.guidance: Actual source-backed year/range, not a value inferred from a photograph.

vehicle_specs.body.label: Body style and doors
vehicle_specs.body.guidance: Actual body style and door count; not a promise of off-road or accessibility suitability.

vehicle_specs.capacity.label: Passenger and luggage constraints
vehicle_specs.capacity.guidance: Separate passengers, bag counts/dimensions and relevant child/accessibility options.

vehicle_specs.features.label: Guaranteed amenities and extras
vehicle_specs.features.guidance: Actual air conditioning, charging, equipment or other guaranteed features; options need actual resource availability.

bike_specs.fit.label: Frame, wheel and rider fit information

requirement.when: when relevant to the actual bike type

bike_specs.fit.guidance: Named units and actual manufacturer fit guidance; rider height is not a guaranteed universal fit.

bike_specs.controls.label: Transmission, gearing and drive type
bike_specs.controls.guidance: Actual mechanical/powered configuration and supported accessories.

session_specs.level.label: Activity level and actual audience scope
session_specs.level.guidance: Merchant/provider-defined level and prerequisites; do not infer suitability from age alone.

session_specs.programme.label: Programme, curriculum or included segments

requirement.when: when a programme or curriculum is sold

session_specs.programme.guidance: Actual sessions/segments, quantities and admission entitlement; not an automatic reservation of each segment.

session_specs.equipment.label: Included versus required customer equipment

requirement.when: when equipment or materials are relevant

session_specs.equipment.guidance: Separate included, optional charged and customer-supplied items.

session_specs.access.label: Published access and participation conditions
session_specs.access.guidance: Only actual approved venue/provider conditions and accessibility information.

photography_specs.formats.label: Delivered file or print formats
photography_specs.formats.guidance: Actual quantity, resolution/size basis, file/print type and whether raw files are included.

photography_specs.coverage.label: People, locations and change limits

requirement.when: when limits affect scope or price

photography_specs.coverage.guidance: Named counts/time/locations and relevant unit; private participant details remain in the request.

financial_provider_specs.product.label: Exact provider service or product name
financial_provider_specs.product.guidance: Separate the actual provider offering from Banking, Insurance or another merchant identity.

financial_provider_specs.terms_source.label: Authoritative terms and effective time
financial_provider_specs.terms_source.guidance: Approved source/version, validity and indicative versus executable status. No invented rate or return promise.

financial_provider_specs.documents.label: Private application information route

requirement.when: when necessary for the provider handoff

financial_provider_specs.documents.guidance: Collect only applicable information through the authorized provider process; never publish identity/financial documents.

florist_specs.palette.label: Actual colour palette and permitted substitutions
florist_specs.palette.guidance: Show which features are fixed and which can vary seasonally; do not guarantee unconfirmed varieties.

florist_specs.care.label: Arrangement care and delivery presentation
florist_specs.care.guidance: Merchant-confirmed instructions and actual vase/packaging inclusion.

gift_specs.item.label: Base item type, material and dimensions
gift_specs.item.guidance: Mug, printed garment, keepsake or actual item; explicit dimensions/units and material, distinct from personalization.

gift_specs.approval.label: Personalization limits and proof acceptance
gift_specs.approval.guidance: Character/file/design limits and proof process. Actual recipient text and files stay private.

meal_specs.base.label: Actual main dish or bread/base type

requirement.when: when the choice defines the item

meal_specs.base.guidance: Actual supported base and composition; options carry relevant ingredients and charges.

meal_specs.inclusions.label: Included sides, sauces and drinks

requirement.when: when part of a meal or combo

meal_specs.inclusions.guidance: Separate included quantity from optional charged additions and supported substitutions.

meal_specs.choice_rules.label: Required/optional choices and incompatibilities
meal_specs.choice_rules.guidance: Minimum/maximum selections, actual compatibility, prices and availability are explicit.

dairy_specs.kind.label: Milk, dairy or egg product and source
dairy_specs.kind.guidance: Actual product/species/source where labelled; no invented provenance.

dairy_specs.format.label: Form, treatment or labelled fat/grade
dairy_specs.format.guidance: Actual fresh/UHT/cultured or egg grade/size information, preserving the source and units where relevant.

dairy_specs.contents.label: Container size or egg count
dairy_specs.contents.guidance: Actual volume/mass/count and pack quantity; separate product contents from shipping weight.

cold_food_specs.state.label: Labelled ambient, chilled or frozen condition
cold_food_specs.state.guidance: Actual labelled condition, including ambient products where applicable; an unanswered value is not a storage or safety claim.

cold_food_specs.handling.label: Applicable cold-chain and storage instructions

requirement.when: when required for the specific product

cold_food_specs.handling.guidance: Use actual product and fulfilment-owner requirements; no inferred storage/safety advice.

laundry_specs.care.label: Applicable garment/item care restrictions
laundry_specs.care.guidance: Actual accepted fabrics/item types and assessment needs; do not assume one treatment applies to every textile.

laundry_specs.quantity.label: Counting/weighing and estimate adjustment method
laundry_specs.quantity.guidance: Explicit unit, minimum, assessed quantity and customer acceptance of any revised price.

laundry_specs.packaging.label: Folding, hanging and return packaging choices
laundry_specs.packaging.guidance: Actual choices, applicable quantities and additional charges.

textile_specs.fit.label: Actual bed, mattress, window or item fit
textile_specs.fit.guidance: Named dimensions, drop/depth/orientation and units; a queen/king label is not a universal measurement.

textile_specs.pieces.label: Exact pieces and mounting accessories
textile_specs.pieces.guidance: Separate included cover/pillowcase/lining/hooks and optional mounting/installation.

lighting_specs.fitting.label: Fixture, lamp base and mounting type
lighting_specs.fitting.guidance: Actual fitting/socket/base and included or replaceable lamp.

lighting_specs.output.label: Published light-output and colour specification
lighting_specs.output.guidance: Named lumen/colour-temperature or actual rating method and units; no invented equivalent wattage.

lighting_specs.installation.label: Mounting, supply and environmental requirements
lighting_specs.installation.guidance: Actual manufacturer/site requirements and supported installation scope.

medical_product_specs.kind.label: Exact device or consumable kind
medical_product_specs.kind.guidance: A specific device/consumable rather than a generic Medical Supplies listing.

medical_product_specs.fit.label: Size, model and compatible components

requirement.when: when fit or compatibility is relevant

medical_product_specs.fit.guidance: Actual dimensions/units and manufacturer compatibility, never a personalized clinical recommendation.

medical_product_specs.power.label: Power and included operating components
medical_product_specs.power.guidance: Actual manufacturer ratings and contents; no inferred clinical performance.

medical_product_specs.label.label: Approved label/version and instructions reference
medical_product_specs.label.guidance: Authoritative product content and verification; this plan does not set legal classifications or clinical guidance.

baby_equipment_specs.type.label: Actual equipment or feeding accessory type
baby_equipment_specs.type.guidance: The specific item controls size, compatible parts and included pieces.

baby_equipment_specs.adjustments.label: Manufacturer-labelled adjustment and fit
baby_equipment_specs.adjustments.guidance: Actual age/weight/dimension labels with units; do not infer safety or suitability.

baby_equipment_specs.care.label: Assembly, cleaning and replacement-part reference
baby_equipment_specs.care.guidance: Use approved manufacturer instructions and actual compatible parts.

health_service_specs.kind.label: Consultation, session, procedure or panel type
health_service_specs.kind.guidance: Specific provider-defined service; broad clinic identity cannot supply its scope.

health_service_specs.inclusions.label: Included service segments and exclusions

requirement.when: when the offered service has separately defined segments or included tests

health_service_specs.inclusions.guidance: Actual provider-approved scope and duration basis, not inferred outcomes.

health_service_specs.administration.label: Approved administrative intake and preparation

requirement.when: when needed for the selected service

health_service_specs.administration.guidance: Only necessary purpose-limited inputs; results, diagnosis and clinical notes remain with their authorized private system.

audio_specs.kind.label: Headphone, speaker or actual audio form
audio_specs.kind.guidance: Specific construction/form factor controls the applicable specifications.

audio_specs.microphone.label: Microphone and control functions
audio_specs.microphone.guidance: Confirmed functions and compatible systems; not inferred from connector shape.

audio_specs.supplied.label: Included cables, charging case or mounting

computer_specs.system.label: Operating system and included licence scope
computer_specs.system.guidance: Actual installed/licensed edition and supported updates; no unlicensed software promise.

computer_specs.upgrade.label: Supported memory, storage and expansion
computer_specs.upgrade.guidance: Confirmed model-specific slots/limits and units; do not infer from the product family.

computer_specs.condition.label: Actual condition and refurbished disclosures
computer_specs.condition.guidance: Actual grade/defects and sourced condition; private serials remain internal.

tour_specs.mode.label: Walking, vehicle, boat or other actual mode
tour_specs.mode.guidance: Actual transport/activity mode; associated capacity and provider constraints remain authoritative.

tour_specs.language.label: Available guide or service languages

requirement.when: when a guide or language-specific service is offered

tour_specs.language.guidance: Actual supported language choices and any availability constraint.

tour_specs.lodging.label: Lodging category, room/meal choices and supplier scope
tour_specs.lodging.guidance: Named actual inclusions/choices; desired accommodation is not confirmed supplier inventory.

tour_specs.changes.label: Weather, substitution and supplier change terms
tour_specs.changes.guidance: Actual approved supplier terms; no invented travel or medical advice.

travel_intake.dates.label: Requested travel dates and flexibility

travel_intake.party.label: Traveller counts and relevant service needs
travel_intake.party.guidance: Necessary party quantities and preferences only; sensitive documents use an authorized separate process when actually required.

travel_intake.itinerary.label: Destinations, lodging/transport preferences and budget

merchantTabs.label: History
groups: Changes, chart/policy versions and source conflicts

customerSections.label: Browse card
customerSections.behavior: Name, actual photo, selected meaningful highlights and accurately labelled price. Full measurement charts stay on the detail page.

customerSections.label: Product details
customerSections.behavior: Accurate gallery and title, brand/maker, description and included pieces.

customerSections.label: Specifications
customerSections.behavior: Group material, construction and item-specific facts using readable labels and units. Omit irrelevant fields.

customerSections.label: Choose size and colour
customerSections.behavior: Only real combinations; retain an unavailable option with a clear reason where appropriate, never silently substitute.

customerSections.label: Size guide and fit
customerSections.behavior: Highlight the selected size row, with body/garment and circumference/flat-width basis. Explicit units and variant-specific overrides apply.

customerSections.label: Selected price
customerSections.behavior: Update the actual selected variant price and quantities; separate supported extras and any estimate/quote-only state.

customerSections.label: Delivery or collection
customerSections.behavior: Show actual location eligibility, lead time and permitted methods from their authority.

customerSections.label: Care, returns and service terms
customerSections.behavior: Display applicable care, returns, warranty or tailoring/styling terms before commitment.

customerSections.label: Service scheduling
customerSections.behavior: Only relevant for actual styling/fitting appointments or configured production promises; product stock is separate.

customerSections.label: Private tailoring request
customerSections.behavior: Customer measurements, reference uploads and contact details remain private transaction input.

screenImpacts.effect: Show accepted garment/variant, piece, colour/size and chart/policy snapshot; private tailoring inputs only to authorized staff. Preserve product orders versus fitting appointments and accepted production work.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-WK01: an accepted dress order retains the selected size, colour, variant ID and accepted chart/price/policy versions after the merchant edits the current chart. A viewer without tailoring access cannot open personal measurements.

screenImpacts.effect: Specific item selection, grouped fashion fields, real variants and units, size charts, scoped defaults, customer preview and missing-information review.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-OF01: choose Dress, enter its applicable construction fields, create real size/colour variants, attach a size guide with units/basis, then inspect each variant in Customer preview. A skirt omits inseam; a ring uses its ring-size guide; changing type reviews incompatible saved fields.

screenImpacts.effect: Variant/branch stock for products; separate fitting/styling appointment resources and production/due capacity for tailoring. A product does not gain an appointment calendar.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-AV01: size M at one branch can be unavailable while size L or another branch differs. A styling appointment uses provider/time capacity; purchasing the dress never consumes a fitting slot.

screenImpacts.effect: Maintain brand/maker defaults, location applicability, shared versioned charts and public policy references without treating merchant specialty as a restriction on actual offerings.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-BU01: updating a shared chart previews affected listings and preserves explicit item/variant overrides. A shop can add an applicable offering without changing its primary merchant identity.

screenImpacts.effect: Use accepted variant/quantity/extra prices, applicable policy versions and authoritative refund facts; size-chart edits never rewrite historical charges.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-MO01: a different price for a real variant is reflected in the accepted order and applicable refund calculation. A later chart or current-price edit does not change that historical amount.

screenImpacts.effect: Target real eligible variants and locations, accurately show from/selected price and stock-dependent eligibility, and preserve the correct colour image.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-PR01: a promotion restricted to specified variants/branches shows the right image, price basis and actual eligibility. It does not advertise an unavailable size as available or apply to an excluded variant.

screenImpacts.effect: Allow meaningful item/type/variant dimensions where source data exists; missing size, stock or fit-return reasons remain unavailable rather than inferred.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-IN01: report only known item/type/variant dimensions with declared data coverage. Missing fit-return reasons are unavailable; they are not inferred from size or a customer's body.

screenImpacts.effect: Declare source/edit ownership for product details, chart versions, prices and stock; map imported size/colour/measurement fields and restrict private tailoring access.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-SE01: an imported size/chart maps its actual system, units and measurement basis. Conflicting source-owned values enter review; external prices/stock remain under their owner and private tailoring fields remain restricted.

reviewQuestions: Which measurements should block publication for each garment type, and when is a clear not-provided state acceptable?
Which existing merchant size charts can be reused accurately, and who maintains updates and exceptions?
Are the proposed construction choices and separate ring, necklace, bracelet, earring and smartwatch templates sufficient for the actual ranges?

reviewDecisions.proposal: The published/conditional/optional labels are proposed completeness requirements. Validate them with representative merchants and the existing readiness policy owner before runtime enforcement.

Preserve unknown values and allow drafts. Do not infer measurements from M/L or cross-system size conversion. Review whether a specific item may publish with a visible incomplete size guide or must complete it first.

The named types are a curated initial catalogue across every current specialty, not every conceivable future SKU. Add a specific template or reviewed typed extension when the actual item needs different fields.
Pin versions and show affected listings before applying a shared update. Choose explicit item/variant/location overrides and preserve accepted historical facts.

The user approved all 21 listed additions for design inclusion on 31 October 2026. They are compiled as approved per-offering profile extensions; runtime setup, authority, policy and capacity requirements remain applicable.

Use approved provider/manufacturer information and policy/verification owners for pharmacy, health, financial and restricted goods. Define exact applicable requirements during implementation without inventing thresholds or claims in the mapping.

Map source attributes and preserve IDs, relationships and private values. Missing fields stay unresolved; legacy descriptions cannot reliably supply measurements, compatibility, clinical or financial facts.

The existing catalogue uses whole-KES fields while the NEXG contract summary calls for minor units and currency. Resolve the owner-approved mapping and rounding explicitly before any migration; this package performs none.

Review real sample listings and task completion across every family. Automated coverage establishes mapping/reference consistency only, not correct provider terms, successful shopping or a working portal.

experienceMap.categoryPolicy: Merchant identities suggest offering types. The selected actual product/service kind composes fields and customer screens; enabled owner capabilities choose supported workflows. No per-category backend or parallel state machine is introduced.
experienceMap.workflowSelectionPolicy: Template flow illustrations reuse registered model/schema contracts. Actual specialty offeringRoutes retain the historical or approved per-offering workflow references, intake modes and source guards. Do not replace a regulated, remote, greeting or other specialty route with a generic model illustration.

specificationStages.label: Merchant captures the offering
specificationStages.invariant: Use the actual specific template and applicable typed fields; missing data remains unresolved.

specificationStages.label: Validate and publish
specificationStages.invariant: Apply the existing publication, source, policy and access gates. Category choice alone is insufficient.

specificationStages.label: Customer discovers and understands
specificationStages.invariant: Public projection includes the relevant specifications and no private/internal values.

specificationStages.label: Customer selects actual options
specificationStages.invariant: Retain actual variant and choice references, units, compatibility and specification overrides.

specificationStages.label: Owners check price and feasibility
specificationStages.invariant: The named independent owners revalidate actual quantities, resources, locations and price basis; unknown remains unknown.

specificationStages.label: Review terms and submit the selected command
specificationStages.invariant: Bind accepted specification/price/policy versions and purpose-limited private intake to the actual existing model workflow.

specificationStages.label: Execute the existing workflow
specificationStages.invariant: Use registered workflow transitions, owner guards and accurate independent allocation/payment/fulfilment/sync outcomes.

specificationStages.label: Complete or change accepted work
specificationStages.invariant: Completion, amendment, cancellation and any refund use their actual supported owners and preserve accepted historical facts.

merchantScreens.label: Work
merchantScreens.behavior: Show the actual accepted offering and selected variants/options, quantity/unit and specification/price/policy versions. Render the existing selected workflow's permitted stages and commands. Private intake is restricted to its purpose and role; never show it in public product data.
merchantScreens.scenario: A later listing/specification edit leaves accepted work unchanged. Product orders, appointments, rentals, custom production, quotes, memberships, freight and storage retain their own workflow and independent payment/allocation/sync states.

merchantScreens.label: Offerings
merchantScreens.behavior: Choose the actual product/service kind, then compose the shared, type-specific and conditional input groups. Capture typed values, units, real variants, option compatibility, source and scope. Preview every customer destination before publishing through the existing owner gates.
merchantScreens.scenario: Each mapped offering exposes its actual field matrix. Irrelevant construction fields are omitted; type changes review incompatible values; import preserves IDs, data quality and private/public boundaries.

merchantScreens.label: Availability
merchantScreens.behavior: Show the applicable availability model for the selected offering: stock by variant/location, exact resource/interval, dated places, compatible spaces, paired windows, accepted workload, redemption or nonblocking request. Unit, time basis, source freshness and confirmation authority stay explicit.
merchantScreens.scenario: Unknown stock/capacity cannot become available. A product purchase does not reserve an appointment, a plan does not reserve its sessions, and an unaccepted request does not block capacity. Selected options recheck all actual constraints.

merchantScreens.label: Business
merchantScreens.behavior: Maintain shared identity, permitted activities/locations, applicable policy/verification references and explicitly reusable specification defaults. Item and variant overrides retain their own scope/version. Business category suggests forms but does not describe or restrict the entire catalogue.
merchantScreens.scenario: A shared chart, policy or default change previews the affected offerings and preserves explicit overrides and accepted historical facts. A seller declaration never creates a verified badge or provider authority.

merchantScreens.label: Money
merchantScreens.behavior: Use the accepted actual item/variant/option, quantity/unit or interval and versioned price/charge terms. Distinguish starting estimates, quote-only, deposits, recurring consent and final total. Payment, refund, settlement and payout facts remain with their separate owners.
merchantScreens.scenario: A listing edit does not rewrite an accepted price. Per-unit, time, person, pack, carrier and storage bases retain their units and approved calculations; neither a paid amount nor a successful form proves service confirmation.

merchantScreens.label: Promotions

customerScreens.label: Price and charge breakdown

customerScreens.label: Delivery, collection or service location
customerScreens.behavior: Show supported methods, exact location eligibility and authoritative estimates/promises. Unknown service coverage and freshness do not become a guaranteed delivery.

customerScreens.label: Date, time or capacity selection

customerScreens.label: Terms and eligibility
customerScreens.behavior: Show applicable approved return/cancellation/deposit/usage/eligibility/renewal/provider terms before commitment. A seller answer does not establish verification or permission.

customerScreens.label: Private order, booking or enquiry input
customerScreens.behavior: Collect only necessary purpose-specific inputs and customer choices for this offering/model. Public form definitions and private responses remain distinct. Show pending versus accepted outcomes accurately.

customerScreens.label: Review and confirmation
customerScreens.behavior: Review the actual selected item/variant/options, quantity/unit or interval, accepted price and policy references before the owner command. Confirmation, allocation, payment, fulfilment and notifications remain separate outcomes.

customerScreens.label: Order, booking or request progress
customerScreens.behavior: Show the existing selected workflow's actual states and permitted customer actions from authoritative work. Quotes, requests, production, rentals, entitlements and provider handoffs do not become generic delivery orders.

measurementGuide.composition: Chart/guide definitions, size rows and named measurement columns compose one typed control. Capture each actual value once, with unit/basis and variant/piece scope; a linked shared chart is a versioned reference, not a second independent set of values.
